name: Nebraska State Fair Seasonal Job: Cleaning Squad
what_you_do: Keep the fairgrounds tidy during the Nebraska State Fair. You are on your feet for hours and work on your own. This is the one 2026 fair job on the flyer open to age 16.
who_can_apply: Applicants must be 16 or older for the Cleaning Squad. Most other fair jobs need 18 or more.
pay_detail: Rate of pay starts at $15 per hour (2026 flyer).
duration: 2026 fair shifts: August 28 to September 7, 2026, plus training and orientation
deadline_text: 2026 shifts were August 28 to September 7, 2026. 2027 hiring not posted yet on the program page.
how_to_apply: Fill out the employment application on the fair careers page. It is online or in PDF. You can also pick one up at the State Fair Administrative Office, 501 E Fonner Park Rd, Suite 200, Grand Island, NE 68801. Or email it to the address on the flyer.
notes: Quote from the flyer: Applicants must be 16 years of age. The online application has a Social Security No. field and asks if you are authorized to work in the United States. Whether a Nebraska work permit is needed was not stated on the program pages.
